    basic = {
        'name': 'John Smith',
        'death_date': '1688',
        'key': '/a/OL6398451A',
        'birth_date': '1650',
        'type': _atype,
    }
    full_dates = {
        'name': 'John Smith',
        'death_date': '23 June 1688',
        'key': '/a/OL6398452A',
        'birth_date': '01 January 1650',
        'type': _atype,
    }
    full_different = {
        'name': 'John Smith',
        'death_date': '12 June 1688',
        'key': '/a/OL6398453A',
        'birth_date': '01 December 1650',
        'type': _atype,
    }
    no_death = {
        'name': 'John Smith',
        'key': '/a/OL6398454A',
        'birth_date': '1650',
        'type': _atype,
    }
    no_dates = {'name': 'John Smith', 'key': '/a/OL6398455A', 'type': _atype}
    non_match = {
        'name': 'John Smith',
        'death_date': '1999',
        'key': '/a/OL6398456A',
        'birth_date': '1950',
        'type': _atype,
    }
    different_name = {'name': 'Jane Farrier', 'key': '/a/OL6398457A', 'type': _atype}
